joined.title: Paper is outrunning revenue
joined.subtitle: Contract intake (DocuSign) x deals closed (Salesforce) x open matters (SharePoint) - indexed, Sep = 100

insight.headline: July intake hit 138 contracts, +44% vs Sep, while closed deals rose just 15% — paper is outrunning revenue
insight.detail: Joining DocuSign intake against Salesforce closed-won shows the Jun-Aug surge is reps front-loading paper ahead of the Sep 30 quota gate, not new revenue — while SharePoint's matter load quietly grinds to a 12-month high of 54. DocuSign sees only volume, Salesforce sees only bookings, SharePoint sees only disputes; no single system shows legal absorbing a speculative paper wave with rising matter risk and zero matching revenue.
insight.action: Ask Marcus Webb for a 2-week deal-to-paper forecast and gate speculative pre-quota contracts behind a Salesforce opportunity-stage check
